entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence length is 768 residues and contains two ambiguous X residues; physicochemical calculations were therefore skipped.
Pfam detects a complete Mur-ligase-like module at approximately residues 19-432: Mur_ligase, Mur_ligase_M, and Mur_ligase_C domains.
Pfam detects a second partial Mur-ligase-like module at approximately residues 489-756: Mur_ligase and Mur_ligase_M domains, with no detected C-terminal Mur_ligase_C domain before sequence end.

Top Swiss-Prot similarities are to MurE proteins from Rickettsia species, with about 39-41% identity across approximately 56-57% of the query; annotation transfer was rejected because coverage was incomplete.
The sequence is extremely Lys/Ile/Asn rich and lacks a clear hydrophobic transmembrane segment in the inspected sequence, favoring a soluble bacterial protein.
The motif-like strings TGTNGKSS and TGSTGKT should not be interpreted as ABC/P-loop signatures without broader domain support; Pfam instead supports Mur ligase architecture.
